Hello, I accidentally deleted my work from 18:00 to 18:12 on the evening of October 16th in Taiwan, because I will use multiple backups just in case. Then I uploaded the most complete one and then deleted the old one. I accidentally deleted the most complete one, leaving the oldest backup. As a result, I am not in the mood to do it again a second time. I don’t know if I can ask customer service to call it back. Although I have a second backup, the second backup only has 24 events, and the one I made has 64. Hello, tonight, October 16th, from 6:00 PM to 6:12 PM (Taiwan time), I accidentally deleted my work, "A Belated Letter from the Green Mountains: The Everlasting White City." Because I usually have multiple backups just in case, I uploaded the most complete version and then deleted the older ones, but I accidentally deleted the most complete one, leaving only the oldest backup. Now I don't feel like redoing it. Please help me get my data and my work back. Subject: Request to Recover an Accidentally Deleted Published Episode Hello Frontia Support Team, I accidentally deleted my entire Episode from Frontia Studio. The Episode had already been published, and I spent a significant amount of time creating its story, worldbuilding, characters, and events. The deletion was accidental, and I would sincerely appreciate your help recovering my work. I understand that the Frontia team guide states that deleting an Episode cannot be undone through the normal interface. However, could your technical team please check whether the Episode's data may still exist in server backups or other recoverable records? This work is very important to me, and I would be extremely grateful for any assistance you can provide. Thank you for your time and consideration. The link is to the work I was working on before, and I can't find it now.

您好，我是 Frontia 團隊的 Sion。

在整理備份時不小心刪除了花費大量心血、多達 64 個事件的作品，真的很能理解您現在失落、提不起勁的心情。您透過 1:1 諮詢傳來的訊息我們都已經收到了，讓您等了這麼久還沒收到回覆，真的很抱歉。
首先要誠實地跟您說明，依照 Frontia 的政策，已刪除的作品無法復原，因此我們無法直接協助您恢復這部作品，還請您見諒。不過，我們會再確認看看是否有其他能幫上忙的方式，但結果無法保證。
這個過程需要核對您的帳號與作品資訊，為了保護您的個人資料，不適合在公開頻道進行；另外，這個頻道是用來回報錯誤的公開頻道，並非處理個別諮詢的管道。因此，後續我們會在您已經提出的 1:1 諮詢對話中接續回覆您，不需要再重新提出諮詢，請您留意 App 內 1:1 諮詢的訊息通知。
謝謝您對作品投入的心血，我們會盡力確認。

We've received your 1:1 Support messages — sorry for the wait. Under our policy, deleted episodes cannot be restored, so we're unable to recover it directly, but we'll still check whether there's any other way we can help (no guarantees). Since this involves your account details and this is a public bug-report channel, we'll continue in your existing 1:1 Support chat — no need to submit a new request.
